title: Alexandra Daddario and Andrew Form Are Divorcing — Sources Say It Wasn't One Big Moment
metaDescription: Alexandra Daddario and Andrew Form have filed for divorce after three years of marriage. Insiders describe a slow drift, not a single breaking point.
altText: Relationships news illustration for: Alexandra Daddario and Andrew Form Are Divorcing — Sources Say It Wasn't One Big Moment
html:
When a celebrity divorce is announced, the instinct is to look for the scandal. According to people close to Alexandra Daddario and Andrew Form, there isn't one — and that might be the more interesting story.

Daddario and Form, married for roughly three years, filed for divorce in February 2026. The couple share a son and have said they plan to coparent him together. In a joint statement, their representative said the decision was made "with love and respect."

Sources close to the pair described the split to multiple outlets not as a sudden event, but as something that built up gradually. "They started off hot and heavy, but slowly grew apart after spending time away from each other with their work schedules," one insider said. Another described it bluntly as "a consistent loss of love" rather than any single incident.

Perhaps the most telling detail: even parenthood, which for many couples becomes the glue that holds a shaky relationship together, didn't change the trajectory here. "Having a child together was a reason to be together and in love, but even then, they weren't even doing that together often," a source explained. Eventually, the insider said, "they found not being together easier."

It's a quieter kind of celebrity breakup story — no leaked texts, no public blowup, just two people whose schedules and emotional distance outpaced their marriage. Daddario and Form have both said their focus now is on their son, and on an amicable coparenting arrangement going forward.
